evidence.reason: The supplied Outbox.spool() at lines 521-530 validates the schema, verifies artifacts, and durably writes canonical(value) with no record-size admission check. Because GitLedger.publish() rejects any pending record exceeding RECORD_BYTES (1 MiB) before pushing any group, a schema-valid review that is large enough (many/long payload.paths rows) is admitted to the pending outbox but can never publish, and it stays pending so every later publish fails at the same record. This is an internal inconsistency in existing intended behavior (a queue admitting what its publisher rejects), not a new requirement. The smallest compatible repair is to compute canonical(value) once in spool() and reject values over RECORD_BYTES before the atomic write, matching publish's existing bound; that is a routine correctness fix needing no owner decision.
